field_descriptions.delivery_time: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.
field_descriptions.does_not_ship: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.
field_descriptions.has_shipping_service: Specification of a shipping service offered by the organization.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.shipping_destination: indicates (possibly multiple) shipping destinations. These can be defined in several ways, e.g. postalCode ranges.
field_descriptions.shipping_origin: Indicates the origin of a shipment, i.e. where it should be coming from.
field_descriptions.shipping_rate: The shipping rate is the cost of shipping to the specified destination. Typically, the maxValue and currency values (of the [[MonetaryAmount]]) are most appropriate.
field_descriptions.valid_for_member_tier: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.
field_descriptions.weight: The weight of the product or person.
